address: Korunni 88, Praha 2 - Vinohrady
rent: 24000
total_monthly: 27500
kauce: 48000
commission: unknown
move_in_date: 2026-12-01
lease_type: najem

tools.name: submit_call_result
tools.description: Save the final result of the call. Call exactly once, after the realtor confirmed a viewing time or once it is clear no viewing will be booked, and before saying goodbye.

outcome.description: booked only if the realtor explicitly said yes when you repeated back a viewing time fully inside a free window. Otherwise not_booked: no agreement, a time outside the windows, maybe, a call back, the realtor has to check, or the call ending early.

viewing_start.description: Agreed viewing start as ISO 8601 with the Europe/Prague offset, in the same form as the free window times, for example 2026-11-14T10:30:00+01:00. Set only when outcome is booked. Leave out when not booked.

answers.description: One item per question asked during the call, including the VAT question. Empty list when none were answered.

items.description: A question and the realtor's answer.

question.description: The question that was asked, in a few words.

answer.description: What the realtor said, in a few words. Use unknown when they did not know or did not answer.

new_costs.description: Costs the realtor mentioned that are not in the fact sheet. Leave out a cost with no stated amount and mention it in the summary instead. Empty list when there are none.

items.description: One cost with a stated amount.

label.description: Short name of the cost, for example parking or internet.

recurring.description: true when the cost repeats monthly, false when it is paid once.

summary.description: One or two sentences on what happened in the call, with the reason when not booked.

tools.name: mark_question_asked
tools.description: Tick an extra question on the screen. Call right after you asked that item of the extra questions list aloud, once per item. Do not mention it and do not wait for a result.

number.description: The 1-based number of the item in the numbered extra questions list.
